cards.answer: Neeko is a mage/support who uses disguises and a clone to set up roots and a nearby knockup into a stun. Her damage is mainly magic, with AP scaling.
cards.counterplay: Keep space from suspicious units, dodge her root sideways, and spread out when she approaches.

citations.quote: Name: Neeko. Official role tags: Mage, Support.
Neeko can look like an ally champion or as other units on the map.
Active: Neeko creates a clone of her current form, together they enter brief invisibility and gain bonus move speed for a short time.
Active: Neeko slings a magical spiral in the target direction that deals magic damage and roots enemies hit.
Afterwards, Neeko briefly leaps upward and knocks up nearby enemies. She then lands to emit a burst of energy that deals magic damage and briefly stuns nearby enemies.

facts.claim: uses disguises and a clone to set up roots and a nearby knockup into a stun.

citations.quote: Initial Magic Damage:60 / 110 / 160 / 210 / 260 (+ 60% AP)
Bonus Magic Damage:30 / 65 / 100 / 135 / 170 (+ 60% AP)
Magic Damage:150 / 350 / 550 (+ 120% AP)

facts.claim: Her damage is mainly magic, with AP scaling.

cards.priority_reason: Her deception and area crowd control define how enemies should approach fights.

cards.answer: Neeko can disguise herself as an allied champion or a collected non-champion unit, and basic attacks can preserve her disguise. Immobilization, damaging abilities, or damage lethal to the disguise's form break it.
cards.counterplay: Treat suspicious units cautiously and use immobilizing crowd control to help expose her.

citations.quote: Neeko has a collection of disguises to take on the appearance of allied champions.
Standing near a non-champion unit will collect its Sho'Ma, adding its disguise to the collection.
While disguised, Neeko can use basic attacks while keeping her form.

facts.claim: Neeko can disguise herself as an allied champion or a collected non-champion unit, and basic attacks can preserve her disguise.

citations.quote: The disguise will break when Neeko takes "lethal" damage, becomes immobilized, or performs her damaging abilities.
takes damage lethal to the disguise's form

facts.claim: Immobilization, damaging abilities, or damage lethal to the disguise's form break it.

cards.priority_reason: Disguises let her approach from unexpected positions and remain disguised while attacking.

cards.answer: Blooming Burst deals magic damage in an area. Hitting a champion or large monster, or killing an enemy, triggers another bloom in the same area; subsequent blooms can repeat this effect.
cards.counterplay: Move out of the impact area promptly and avoid lingering near units the burst may kill.

citations.quote: Active: Neeko tosses a seed that bursts upon landing at the target location, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies.

facts.claim: Blooming Burst deals magic damage in an area.

citations.quote: If the burst kills an enemy or hits a champion or large monster, the seed blooms after 0.75 seconds to burst again, dealing magic damage to enemies in the same area. This may occur up to 2 times per cast.

facts.claim: Hitting a champion or large monster, or killing an enemy, triggers another bloom in the same area; subsequent blooms can repeat this effect.

cards.priority_reason: Leaving the area limits exposure to repeated damage.

cards.answer: Shapesplitter periodically empowers Neeko's basic attack with bonus magic damage and a brief movement speed boost. Activating it creates a clone of her current form, briefly makes Neeko and the clone invisible, and grants movement speed; she can redirect the clone.
cards.counterplay: Avoid extended attack trades and reassess her position after she uses the clone before committing.

citations.quote: Neeko passively deals bonus magic damage every third attack, briefly increasing her move speed.

Recast: Neeko directs the clone to the target location.

facts.claim: Activating it creates a clone of her current form, briefly makes Neeko and the clone invisible, and grants movement speed; she can redirect the clone.

cards.priority_reason: The clone and brief invisibility complicate targeting and pursuit.

cards.answer: Tangle-Barbs passes through enemies, dealing magic damage and rooting them. After hitting an enemy, it becomes larger and faster and roots later targets for longer.
cards.counterplay: Dodge sideways and avoid lining up behind minions or teammates.

citations.quote: Neeko slings a tangle that damages and roots everything it passes through.
Active: Neeko slings a magical spiral in the target direction that deals magic damage to enemies hit and roots them for a duration.

facts.claim: After hitting an enemy, it becomes larger and faster and roots later targets for longer.

cards.priority_reason: Its empowered root makes standing behind other targets dangerous.

cards.answer: Pop Blossom winds up, then knocks up nearby enemies before dealing magic damage and stunning them on landing. A disguise hides the initial preparation, but breaks during the windup.
cards.counterplay: Keep distance from her approach and spread out to reduce exposure to her area crowd control.

citations.quote: Afterwards, Neeko briefly leaps upward and knocks up nearby enemies. She then lands to emit a burst of energy that deals magic damage and briefly stuns nearby enemies.
